args.subtitle: An ethereal voyage through a weightless orbital station.
args.title: Orbital Hangar No. 01
args.quote: The void is not empty; it is the space where desire begins to hover.
why: The concrete transition pillars define the airlock, forcing a deliberate, slow entry into the hangar.
The central levitation plinth serves as the gravity-defying anchor, framing the eyewear as artifacts of a future world.
The perimeter display clusters break the loop, creating a tactical rhythm of exploration between the central core and the station edges.
The transaction control panel at the rear brings your journey to a final, steady docking point at the hangar's limit.
args.synopsis: You enter the hangar, slipping between steel columns like a vessel docking at a remote station. Ahead, the central levitation plinth pulls your gaze as eyewear orbits the center in a state of suspended animation. You move through the cool air, circling the void while the soft hum of the facility vibrates beneath your feet. Only by stepping away can you reach the perimeter, where the gear is finally grounded.
args.line: Step into the silence of an orbital hangar, where your perception of gravity dissolves among floating light.

stops.cap: I pass between the towering pillars, feeling the magnetic pull of the threshold.
stops.sub: The hangar hums with a stillness that suggests space is expanding.

stops.cap: The plinth stands suspended in the center, and the eyewear floats as if held by a hidden force.
stops.sub: I approach slowly, performing my own docking maneuver in the silence.

stops.cap: I turn away from the core to inspect the product, grounded by the weight of the steel clusters.
stops.sub: Even here, the memory of weightlessness lingers in the cold metal.
